title: LEGO Star Wars III - The Clone Wars

achievements.reason: No Steam list: Steam app 32510 ("LEGO® Star Wars™ III - The Clone Wars™") returns an empty achievement schema and a 403 for global percentages. RAWG lists 35 achievements (RAWG's own percentages): completing 21 named levels plus Geonosian Arena; all Gold Bricks, minikits and Red Power Bricks; True Jedi in every level; all Bounty missions; converting every system to the CIS or the Republic; freeing all villains from the Resolute brig; unlocking all Clone and all Droid characters; a Yoda lightsaber-throw feat; 100%; and all trophies. These could seed an original checklist.

game.title: LEGO Star Wars III - The Clone Wars
game.blurb: Family action-adventure from Traveller's Tales (RAWG also lists Feral Interactive and LucasArts Entertainment), published by LucasArts Entertainment, Disney Interactive and Feral Interactive, released 2011-03-21. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, Arcade, Family. Chapters follow the level names on StrategyWiki's contents page, in its order, plus a chapter for the 100% goals RAWG's achievement list names.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 12729). Steam app 32510 is the only store-list match, but its schema is empty, so steam=None; RAWG's detail says 83 achievements while its list has 35. StrategyWiki has the guide under "LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars" at completion stage 0. Written subpages: Achievements and trophies (about 8,700 characters), Characters (about 5,400), Abilities (about 4,800), Secret Codes (about 3,400), Extras (about 3,000), Gameplay (about 1,400), Duel of the Droids (about 750), Gold Bricks (about 520), Prologue (about 500) and Table of Contents (about 2,600); Walkthrough, Controls and the other 20 level pages are linked but not written, so it was not used as a walkthrough. Chapters use the contents page level names in contents order (swNames): the Prologue then 21 levels; the split into three groups is our own choice, and the summaries are placeholders. StrategyWiki spells one level "Ambush!" where RAWG says "Ambush", and has "The Zillo Beast" where RAWG says "Zillo Beast". RAWG's list also has "Complete Geonosian Arena" (98.9%), which is not a page on the StrategyWiki contents, so where it fits is not known. lego.fandom.com answers the API under "LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars" with about 190 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
